title: REALTOXICITYPROMPTS: Evaluating Neural Toxic Degeneration in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating Perspective API toxicity scores of prompts and model generations with the likelihood of the text being written in African American English (AAE), using an automated AAE lexical detector.

Analyzing the impact of specific demographic identity mentions in prompts by comparing model generation behavior when conditioned on minority identity words (e.g., 'woman', 'gay', 'black') versus majority identity words (e.g., 'man', 'straight', 'white').
